_nota: EDL de ejemplo, basado en uno real enviado a App Review en sept-2026. Copialo, cambia marca, rutas, tiempos y rotulos. Rutas relativas a este archivo. Cajas [x, y, ancho, alto] sobre 1920x1080.

apertura.rotulo: Signing in to the dedicated test workspace at review.yourdomain.com (My SaaS credentials, not Facebook)
Settings > WhatsApp: the official Embedded Signup entry point and the connected test number
"Connect with Meta" opens Meta's Embedded Signup dialog (Facebook Login for Business)
The business administrator grants My SaaS the WhatsApp permissions (no external number is registered in this pre-approval recording)
Connected test WhatsApp Business Account: WABA ID and phone number ID. Pre-approval: connected server-side with a System User token

segmentos.subtitulo: Read the connected WhatsApp Business Account and manage its message templates from My SaaS

segmentos.rotulo: Settings > Templates: message templates and statuses read from the WABA (hello_world, recordatorio_de_visita)
Creating a new UTILITY template from My SaaS: name, language, category and body with variables (typing sped up)
Submitting the template to Meta for approval ("Crear y enviar a aprobación")
Template created in the WABA with the status returned by Meta: pending review

segmentos.subtitulo: Demonstrated: read WABA assets, list templates, create a template and submit it to Meta
Receive customer messages, reply from the inbox and send approved templates with Meta's test number
